Initial release: comprehensive US childcare compliance resource.

- Covers licensing, health & safety, staffing, background checks, accreditation, and subsidy compliance for childcare centers and family daycare homes.
- Details staff-to-child ratios, required trainings, and recordkeeping by program type.
- Provides facility safety checklists and step-by-step incident reporting procedures.
- Includes financial compliance guidelines: subsidies, tax, payroll, and QRIS incentives.
- Offers quick-reference tables for key requirements, deadlines, and operational standards.
